front.title: Apple launches research study to explore the use of AI for health
front.tldr: Apple has launched the Apple Health AI Usage Study in the United States, a virtual research study with a companion app exploring how people use AI to answer everyday health questions.

front.title: Tatum scores 32, Celtics set franchise history on the way to 131-94 rout of Mavericks
front.tldr: Jayson Tatum scored 32 points and Derrick White added 16 as the Celtics routed the Mavericks 131-94, their sixth straight win and 11th in their last 12 games.

front.title: Mecanoo transforms former gold vault into 'city's living room' in Amsterdam bank renovation
front.tldr: Dutch firm Mecanoo has completed a major renovation of the Netherlands' central bank in Amsterdam, dismantling a 14-storey tower and opening the former gold vault as public space.

stories.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
stories.tldr: OpenAI researchers set out a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model, with the AI system GPT-6 Astra helping turn the idea into a detailed proof.

stories.title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market
stories.tldr: Bharat Semi has raised a $24 million seed round for its AI-enabled sensor chips, having already secured design wins with companies including General Atomics.

stories.title: Datasette 1.0a43 reaches its streaming milestone, 53% of the way to 1.0
stories.tldr: Simon Willison's Datasette project is now 53% through its 1.0 milestone, with streaming exports among the biggest additions in this release, built partly with help from Claude Fable 5.2.

stories.title: Flaming Hydra's new Kickstarter campaign rethinks e-book ownership and digital lending
stories.tldr: A new Kickstarter campaign for Flaming Hydra aims to rethink e-book ownership and digital lending, pitched by its creators as a return to a more open internet.

stories.title: Samsung is discontinuing several of its mobile apps in December
stories.tldr: Samsung is retiring several of its mobile apps in December, including augmented reality tools for Galaxy devices, giving users limited time to use them before they go.

stories.title: TechCrunch Mobility: The Nvidia backup plan for China's self-driving industry
stories.tldr: TechCrunch's Mobility newsletter examines Nvidia's backup plan for China's self-driving industry, as AI takes an increasingly central role in autonomous vehicle development.

stories.title: The new Apple TV has twice as much RAM as the previous model, but apps and games can't use it
stories.tldr: Apple's new Apple TV 4K ships with an A19 chip, 128GB of storage and 8GB of RAM, double the memory of the previous model, though apps and games cannot yet use the extra capacity.

stories.title: 'Writing With Fire' directors' Himalayan Story Lab unveils fourth cohort, taps Payal Kapadia and Shaunak Sen as mentors
stories.tldr: Oscar-nominated 'Writing With Fire' directors Rintu Thomas and Sushmit Ghosh have launched the fourth cohort of their Himalayan Story Lab documentary fellowship, with Payal Kapadia and Shaunak Sen joining as mentors.

stories.title: 'Toy Story 5' producer reflects on technology's growing complexity, including a curly hair tool built for Blaze
stories.tldr: Toy Story 5 producer Lindsey Collins said the film's technology, including a curly hair tool built specifically for new character Blaze, shows how far Pixar's tools have advanced since A Bug's Life and Ratatouille.

stories.title: Johnny Depp's 'Ebenezer' opens to No. 1 with $19 million, 'How to Rob a Bank' stumbles with $5 million debut
stories.tldr: Johnny Depp's Christmas film 'Ebenezer' opened at number one with $19 million from 3,535 North American theatres, while 'How to Rob a Bank' debuted a distant fifth with $5 million.

stories.title: Final: Lions 35, Patriots 10. Drake Maye injured during lopsided loss in Munich
stories.tldr: Drake Maye left in the first quarter and did not return as the Patriots lost 35-10 to the Lions in Munich, in what has become a difficult season for New England.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli names biggest threat to 2027 title defence as he warns Mercedes advantage may fade
stories.tldr: 2026 champion Kimi Antonelli has named Red Bull's Max Verstappen as the biggest threat to his 2027 title defence, warning that Mercedes' current advantage may not last.

stories.title: Piastri on his tough 2026 and why it could make him stronger
stories.tldr: McLaren's Oscar Piastri reflected on a difficult 2026 season, saying the struggle to tame the MCL40 could ultimately make him a stronger driver next year.

stories.title: The nasty pitch that could help Aroldis evolve
stories.tldr: Red Sox closer Aroldis Chapman is working on a new splitter that could add another dangerous weapon to his pitching arsenal.

finally.title: Tant A Temps Design restores the visual characteristics of Tang architecture in Chinese cafe
finally.tldr: Tant A Temps Design revived the aesthetics of China's Tang Dynasty for the interiors of Laibei 1087, a cafe inside a historic building in Xi'an.
